```yaml
name: Approve Workflows

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, synchronize]

permissions:
  pull-requests: read
  actions: write

jobs:
  approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' &&
      (github.event.action == 'labeled' && github.event.label.name == 'ok-to-test') ||
      github.event.action == 'synchronize'
    steps:
      - name: Check if first-time contributor
        id: check-contributor
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_CREATOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          # Count PRs by this creator in the repository
          # Using env vars to avoid template injection
          PR_COUNT=$(gh api repos/${REPO_NAME}/pulls \
            --jq ".[] | select(.user.login == \"${PR_CREATOR}\")" \
            | wc -l)
          
          echo "PR count for ${PR_CREATOR}: ${PR_COUNT}"
          
          # If PR count is > 1, they are a returning contributor
          if [ "${PR_COUNT}" -gt 1 ]; then
            echo "is_returning_contributor=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "is_returning_contributor=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Check for ok-to-test label
        id: check-label
        env:
          LABELS_JSON: ${{ toJson(github.event.pull_request.labels) }}
        run: |
          HAS_LABEL=false
          # Check if ok-to-test is in the labels array
          if echo "${LABELS_JSON}" | jq -e '.[] | select(.name == "ok-to-test")' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            HAS_LABEL=true
          fi
          echo "has_ok_to_test=${HAS_LABEL}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Approve pending workflows
        if: steps.check-contributor.outputs.is_returning_contributor == 'true' || steps.check-label.outputs.has_ok_to_test == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          # Get pending workflow runs for this PR
          RUNS=$(gh api repos/${REPO_NAME}/actions/runs \
            --jq ".workflow_runs[] | select(.pull_requests[].number == ${PR_NUMBER} and .status == \"queued\") | .id")
          
          if [ -z "${RUNS}" ]; then
            echo "No pending workflow runs found for PR #${PR_NUMBER}"
            exit 0
          fi
          
          for RUN_ID in ${RUNS}; do
            echo "Approving workflow run ${RUN_ID}"
            gh api repos/${REPO_NAME}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}/approve --method POST
          done
```
